We then evaluate CwSG in device-calibrated simulations that replay experimentally measured programming trajectories from 1,189 PCM and 1,268 FM devices.
CLM-MEM-0032.statement: CwSG reaches 84.9% accuracy on SVHN in simulations using measured filamentary memristor trajectories.

extra_quotes: We introduce Channel-wise Spatial Gradient learning (CwSG), a strictly local, forward-only rule that trains each convolutional layer by rewarding spatial variation in its feature maps.

On an MLP architecture (see Methods), where neighboring units have no intrinsic geometric relationship, the one-dimensional difference objective depends on an arbitrary ordering of the hidden units and provides no systematic advantage.
The class-to-channel encoding also requires at least one channel per class in every supervised layer, making narrow layers difficult to reconcile with large class counts.
